title: campanula balcanica var. scheuchzeriformis
intro: Campanula balcanica var. scheuchzeriformis, commonly known as Balkan bellflower, is a plant species in the family Campanulaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Campanula balcanica var. scheuchzeriformis include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
